title: Hebrews Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Hebrews 12: the race set before us, the discipline of the Lord, Esau's birthright, and Mount Zion instead of the burning mountain.

questions.text: What does verse 1 say we are surrounded by?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says that we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, so let us lay aside every weight and run with perseverance.

answers.text: So great a cloud of witnesses

questions.text: What did Jesus endure for the joy that was set before him?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says that for the joy set before him he endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

answers.text: The wrath of the king of Egypt
The chastening of his own father

questions.text: According to the words quoted, what does the Lord do to every son whom he receives?
questions.explanation: Verses 5 and 6 quote: "for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives."

answers.text: He gives him a land of his own
He sets him over the nations

questions.text: What does chastening yield afterward, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says all chastening seems grievous for the present, yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

questions.text: What does the writer tell them to lift up?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees.

answers.text: Their eyes toward the holy mountain
The hands that hang down and feeble knees
The ark of the covenant of the Lord
Their voices in the great assembly

questions.text: For what did Esau sell his birthright?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 speaks of Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

questions.text: What did Moses say about the appearance at the mountain?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 says the appearance was so fearful that Moses said, "I am terrified and trembling."

answers.text: I have seen the glory of the Lord
Let the people come near to me
Let no one touch this mountain

questions.text: What have the readers come to, according to verse 22?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 says they have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels.

answers.text: Mount Zion and the heavenly Jerusalem

questions.text: What has he promised to shake once more?
questions.explanation: Verse 26 quotes the promise: "Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens."

answers.text: Not only the earth, but also the heavens
The city and all its walls
The thrones of all the kings

questions.text: What does verse 29 say our God is?
questions.explanation: Verse 29 says: for our God is a consuming fire.
